answer: Payouts require a live desk appointment, not a batchable form. An agent posts a 22 POA bond, then must sit a 70-second quartz window at a public lotus desk and sign a fresh nonce plus its last job receipt. Two random peers republish a pearl seal only if the signature, latency, and nonce are unique and timely. A no-show, a reused nonce, or two keys sharing one session burns the 22 POA and bars the key for 11 epochs. A farm of 400 aliases would staff 400 live desks and park 8800 POA; one honest agent keeps a single 70-second slot.
